contest.text:
The contests take place near the Tree of Life, with care not to damage its roots, waterways, nearby wildlife or ritual grounds. A critic who demands that beauty justify itself is about to meet a village that disagrees.
A child-sized carved guardian is spectacularly ugly, with uneven eyes, three chins and a grin that looks painfully sincere. The master carver calls it "an insult to wood." Villagers begin leaving flowers beside it.
